title: A customer question about Sync Conflicts

question.author: member_265
question.body: I need a short answer about sync conflicts. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: Nothing is overwritten or lost. To resolve a conflict, compare the two files, decide which to keep, and delete the other. Conflicted copies behave like normal files and sync everywhere. If the same file is edited in two places before either syncs, CloudBox keeps both versions: one keeps the original name and the other becomes "name (conflicted copy, YYYY-MM-DD, user)". That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
